szoveg_eredeti:
Joshua Yang / Washington Post :

 Chinese vendors in Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei market still sell US-restricted Nvidia hardware, quoting $3M+ for Blackwell B300 servers, up from $2M two months ago   —  Though black-market prices have surged amid the turmoil around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, traders in Shenzhen persist in hawking the company's best chips.
